subject: pharmacology
title: Cytotoxic Anticancer IV: 5-Fluorouracil, Capecitabine, DPD Deficiency and Hand-Foot Syndrome

steps.tx: **5-Fluorouracil** (5 FU) impersonates uracil into two crimes: its metabolite FdUMP locks thymidylate synthase (with leucovorin stabilising the lock from the previous lesson) starving DNA of thymidine, while FUTP corrupts RNA processing, killing across gut, marrow and tumour in proportion to exposure schedule. Bolus schedules emphasise marrow, infusional schedules emphasise gut and hand foot injury, which is why FOLFOX and FOLFIRI carry pumps for 46 hours.
steps.say: Schedule writes 5 FU toxicity: bolus hits marrow, infusion hits gut and palms.

left.title: Mechanism double act
points: DPD catabolises over 80 percent of dose

right.title: Schedule signatures
points: Protracted infusion: mucositis, diarrhoea, hand foot
46 hour pumps in FOLFOX and FOLFIRI
Topical 5 FU for actinic keratoses separately

steps.tx: **DPD deficiency** (dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase, DPYD variants) converts standard fluoropyrimidine doses into lethal mucositis, marrow failure, neurotoxicity and death within the first cycle, which is why DPYD genotyping or phenotyping before therapy is now guideline law in many systems, with dose halving or drug avoidance by variant burden. Uridine triacetate, an oral antidote given within 96 hours of overdose or early severe toxicity, completes the safety architecture.
steps.say: Test DPD before the first dose; uridine triacetate is the 96 hour fire exit after.

left.title: DPYD risk system
points: Partial: start at reduced dose, titrate by tolerance
First cycle early severe toxicity is the alarm

right.title: Uridine triacetate rescue
points: Overdose and early life threatening toxicity
Does not reverse established organ injury fully

steps.tx: Fluoropyrimidines such as fluorouracil and capecitabine are cleared by dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase, so the pathway diagram is a safety map. **DPD deficiency**, from DPYD variants, turns an ordinary dose into severe mucositis, failed marrow, nerve toxicity and death during cycle one. Many systems now require DPYD genotyping or phenotyping first, then halve the dose or avoid the drug according to variant burden. Uridine triacetate by mouth, begun before 96 hours elapse after overdose or early severe toxicity, is the rescue.

steps.tx: **Capecitabine** is 5 FU in oral prodrug costume: absorbed intact, converted through liver and tumour enriched thymidine phosphorylase into 5 FU where tumours (and palms) concentrate the final step, dosed twice daily in two weeks on, one week off cycles for colorectal and breast disease. Its hand foot and diarrhoea ledgers exceed infusional 5 FU while marrow lightens, and adherence, food timing and renal dosing become patient executed pharmacology.
steps.say: Capecitabine lets patients swallow the infusion; palms and adherence pay the difference.

left.title: Capecitabine design
points: Three step activation, tumour enriched final step

right.title: Capecitabine burden
points: Missed dose rules: never double up

steps.tx: **Hand foot syndrome** (palmar plantar erythrodysesthesia) grades from tingling and redness (hold, emollients, cool) through blistering pain (stop until recovery, dose reduce) to desquamation disability, shared by capecitabine, infusional 5 FU, liposomal doxorubicin and multikinase inhibitors from later lessons. Regional cooling during infusion and urea creams soften incidence; dose interruption, not stoicism, is the treatment, and recurrence at full dose is a prescribing error.
steps.say: Hand foot syndrome is treated by stopping, not enduring; rechallenge at reduced dose.

nodes.label: Grade 1 tingling and redness: continue, emollients
Resume at reduced dose with cooling habits

steps.tx: **Hand foot syndrome**, also called palmar plantar erythrodysesthesia, grades from tingling and redness, when the drug is held and emollients plus cooling are used, through blistering pain, when treatment stops until recovery and the dose is then reduced, to desquamation that disables the hands and feet. Capecitabine, infusional fluorouracil, liposomal doxorubicin, and some multikinase inhibitors share it. Cooling the limbs during an infusion and urea creams reduce how often it appears. Interrupting the dose is the treatment. Returning at the full dose after a severe episode is a prescribing error.
steps.say: Painful red palms and soles from capecitabine or infusional fluorouracil are hand foot syndrome, also seen with liposomal doxorubicin and some kinase inhibitors. Redness means hold the drug and use emollients. Blisters mean stop, then restart at a lower dose. Full dose rechallenge after severe peeling is a mistake.

vis.alt: Palms and soles show painful redness, swelling, and sheets of peeling skin.
vis.caption: Both palms and both soles are erythematous and tender, with desquamation over pressure points. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Vasospasm ledger** reward a step: coronary spasm (chest pain during infusion, stop and never rechallenge casually, calcium blockers debated), cerebellar ataxia and encephalopathy at high levels (DPD deficiency's neuro face), lacrimal duct stenosis with weeping eyes, and hyperammonaemia in protracted infusions. Chest pain on a 5 FU pump is cardiology and oncology sharing one emergency, vasospasm rather than plaque usually.
steps.say: Chest pain on the pump is 5 FU vasospasm until proven otherwise; stop first, litigate later.

left.title: Cardiac ledger
points: Coronary vasospasm during or after infusion
Nitrate and calcium blocker roles debated

steps.tx: **Fluoropyrimidine combinations** write colorectal oncology's grammar: FOLFOX (leucovorin, 5 FU, oxaliplatin), FOLFIRI (irinotecan swapped in), FOLFOXIRI triplets for fit patients, and capecitabine partnerships (CAPOX) trading pumps for tablets, sequenced and switched by tolerance (oxaliplatin nerves usually retire first) and biology (RAS and BRAF from the targeted lesson deciding antibody partners). The antimetabolite is the constant; partners rotate.
steps.say: Partners rotate around the fluoropyrimidine constant; nerves and mutations call the rotations.

left.title: Regimen grammar
points: Triplet FOLFOXIRI for selected fit patients

right.title: Sequencing drivers
points: RAS, BRAF and sidedness for antibodies
DPYD result before any of it starts

steps.tx: **Topical fluoropyrimidine** deserve their footnote: 5 FU cream destroys actinic keratoses and superficial basal cell carcinomas through weeks of deliberate inflammation patients must be coached to endure, and hepatic arterial floxuridine historically perfused liver metastases exploiting first pass DPD clearance. The same molecule teaches local versus systemic exposure arithmetic dermatologists and oncologists share.
steps.say: Painted on skin, 5 FU inflames on purpose; route is a dose decision.

left.title: Topical fluorouracil
points: Actinic keratosis and superficial BCC courses
DPD deficient patients: systemic absorption caution

right.title: Regional traditions
points: Hepatic arterial floxuridine for liver metastases
Mostly historical beside modern systemic regimens

steps.tx: **Warfarin interaction** the fluoropyrimidine interaction ledger examinations favour: capecitabine and 5 FU raise INR and bleeding (mechanism partly CYP2C9 and vitamin K territory), demanding intensified INR surveillance or anticoagulant reconsideration, while phenytoin levels climb and DPD inhibiting antivirals (brivudine class) are flatly forbidden near fluoropyrimidines after fatal interactions wrote the rule.
steps.say: Check the INR and the viral chart before fluoropyrimidines; two interactions here have killed.
